name: com.tencent.timpush.meizu.MeiZuPushReceiver
description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Meizu adapter receives Meizu registration, message, and status callbacks. It sends Meizu registration IDs to Tencent Cloud IM; its message callbacks are only recorded here.
disableEffect: Tencent Cloud IM stops receiving Meizu registration updates through this receiver, so Meizu offline-push registration stops refreshing.
